newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor markets closed for New Year holidays.
newsitem.headline: India castor markets closed for New Year holidays.

text.p: Indian castor markets are closed for two days for Hindu New Year holidays and reopen on Wednesday, dealers said.
On Friday, prices gained after early falls on fears that a cylone that devastated the southeast coast -- in which at least 2,000 people are feared dead -- may affect crops, traders said.

"The cyclone (which hit Andhra Pradesh on Wednesday) may delay new crop arrivals and even lead to crop loss in some areas," one trader said. Prices fell to 1,089/1,090 rupees from 1,094/1,095 rupees but later in the day rose to 1,093/1,094.
